title: Have electrical work done only by licensed electrical workers
what: Have electrical work performed or supervised only by holders of an electrical work licence.

sources.title: Electrical Safety Act 2022 (NT)
sources.quote: (a) intentionally performs electrical work or supervises another person performing electrical work; and (b) the electrical work requires the person to hold an electrical work licence and the person is reckless in relation to that circumstance; and (c) the person does not hold an electrical work licence
